en.heroLead: Pure-JavaScript WhatsApp Multi-Device API. WebSocket, Noise and Signal, with the forks already merged.

id.heroLead: API WhatsApp Multi-Device murni JavaScript. WebSocket, Noise, dan Signal, dengan semua fork yang sudah digabung.

description.en: What REIN BAILEYS is, which forks it merges, and where to begin.
description.id: Apa itu REIN BAILEYS, fork apa saja yang digabung, dan dari mana harus mulai.

description.en: Install the package, open a socket in ESM or CJS, and keep the connection alive.
description.id: Pasang paket, buka socket dengan ESM atau CJS, dan jaga koneksi tetap hidup.

description.en: Receive events, address JIDs, send text, media, reactions and polls.
description.id: Terima event, alamati JID, kirim teks, media, reaksi, dan polling.

description.en: Group and community management, participants, invites and metadata caching.
description.id: Pengelolaan grup dan komunitas, peserta, undangan, dan cache metadata.

description.en: Channels, newsletter methods, and the built-in auto-follow behaviour.
description.id: Channel, method newsletter, dan perilaku auto-follow bawaan.

description.en: Link a companion device with a phone number instead of scanning a QR code.
description.id: Pasangkan perangkat pendamping dengan nomor telepon tanpa memindai QR.

description.en: Multi-file credentials, custom auth states, database adapters and event replay.
description.id: Kredensial multi-berkas, auth state kustom, adapter database, dan replay event.

description.en: Buttons, carousels, AIRich, native flow, A2UI and the advanced message helpers.
description.id: Tombol, carousel, AIRich, native flow, A2UI, dan helper pesan lanjutan.

description.en: Runnable bots assembled from the socket, store, queue and builder APIs.
description.id: Bot yang bisa dijalankan, dirakit dari API socket, store, antrean, dan builder.

description.en: Every exported name from src/index.js, grouped by category.
description.id: Semua nama yang diekspor dari src/index.js, dikelompokkan per kategori.
